theme: Light landing page with JujuCloud soft top gradient wash, blurred color blobs & dark promise strip block. App keeps CloudIVR blue identity with light/dark theme options.

features: Outlined stroke (1.5px to 2px solid dark slate or brand tone)
Flat solid pastel color fills (lime #daff7c, pink #fbcfe8, sky #bae6fd)
Floating key elements: phone handset, IVR keypad, SMS bubble, SIM card
Hand-drawn squiggle underline (lime) under hero headline key word
Hand-drawn pink circle accent around 'Everything you need'
Curly arrow with handwritten style annotation 'Everything in one place'

grids.pills_cloud_layout: flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center max-w-4xl mx-auto

layouts.hero_section: Centered hero headline + cycling word with lime squiggle underline, floating telecom SVGs + sparkle stars, centered 3-tab hero card (Business phone line / USA eSIM / USA mobile number)
layouts.mock_dashboard_section: Mock 'My numbers' preview panel with browser dots (pink/lime/brand), active badges, overlapping 4-step progress pipeline (Number -> IVR -> SIP -> Live), lime swoosh background, curly arrow annotation
layouts.dark_promise_strip: #07060f rounded-3xl container section with 4 colored promise cards (lime, pink, sky, brand blue)
layouts.feature_pills_cloud: 'Everything you need, and more' section with pink hand-drawn circle & tilted colourful pill tags (lime filled, pink filled, sky outline)
layouts.faq_accordion: Rounded bordered accordion items with circular chevron button and smooth expansion
layouts.final_cta: Dark rounded block with blurred glows and high-contrast CTA button

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle hover lift (-2px), smooth active scale (0.98), hover glow on CTA buttons
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable floating and pulse keyframes when prefers-reduced-motion is active

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text/interactive borders)
accessibility.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing
accessibility.header_overlay_rule: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays over content. Always backdrop-blur or semi-solid fill.

instructions_to_main_agent: Keep CloudIVR blue brand identity (#1d6fd8) on primary buttons/accents across landing & web app.
Ensure all interactive components and buttons carry data-testid attributes.
Use JS/JSX syntax as the codebase consists of React .js files.
Implement the 3 hero card tabs: Business line, USA eSIM, USA mobile number with 1-line pitch and pricing.
Style floating telecom SVGs (handset, keypad, SMS bubble, SIM) with flat fill + outline + offset shadow + float animation.
Implement mock 'My numbers' dashboard preview with status badges and 4-step pipeline (Number -> IVR -> SIP -> Live).
Restyle FAQ accordion with rounded borders and circular chevron controls.
Ensure high contrast AA compliance for all text over lime, pink, sky, or dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid centered generic AI slop layouts; use organic spacing, layered z-index hierarchy, and subtle grain/glows.
Do not use universal transitions like transition: all.
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and interactive containers contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.
